query: 客户隐私保护政策 客户隐私保护政策 衡量企业在个人信息收集、使用、存储和共享方面的治理水平。重点考察“最小必要”原则的落地、用户授权机制、数据留存期限、第三方共享管理及隐私安全事件的应急响应。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备完善的隐私政策，严格遵循“最小必要”原则；建立了动态授权与撤回机制；明确了数据留存与销毁时限；对第三方数据共享有严苛的审计要求，并披露了具体的隐私漏洞响应与补偿机制。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的隐私政策及用户协议，包含基础的收集与使用告知，具备数据加密等保护措施，但缺乏深度的第三方穿透管理、明确的留存期限或用户撤回授权的操作指南。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式隐私政策披露，或仅有笼统的“重视信息安全”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：隐私保护机制覆盖 >80% 的业务线、APP/平台终端及经营地区，且通过了相关的外部审计（如 ISO 27701）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心 APP 具备政策而其他子业务线存在盲区，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 隐私政策 个人信息保护 最小必要 用户授权 数据留存 第三方共享 隐私事件响应 撤回同意 个人信息保护法 PIPL GDPR ISO 27701 privacy policy personal data protection data minimization user consent data retention third-party sharing privacy incident response PIPL GDPR ISO 27701 是否有正式客户/用户隐私政策或用户协议？ 是否披露个人信息收集和使用告知、最小必要原则及用户授权机制？ 用户能否撤回同意、注销账户、访问、更正或删除个人信息？ 是否采用数据加密、脱敏或访问控制？ 数据留存与销毁时限如何规定？ 第三方共享及SDK如何审核和约束？ 隐私事件响应、补偿、外部认证及覆盖范围是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '客户隐私保护政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式客户/用户隐私政策或用户协议？ 是否披露个人信息收集和使用告知、最小必要原则及用户授权机制？ 用户能否撤回同意、注销账户、访问、更正或删除个人信息？ 是否采用数据加密、脱敏或访问控制？ 数据留存与销毁时限如何规定？ 第三方共享及SDK如何审核和约束？ 隐私事件响应、补偿、外部认证及覆盖范围是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“重视信息安全”；仅有网络安全防火墙描述；仅有员工个人信息内控；仅有ISO 27001证书而无隐私政策要点；区分：客户隐私保护政策关注个人信息收集使用共享与用户权利；网络安全风险管理关注攻击监测拦截与应急；治理指标关注董事会层面网络风险监督，不能互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

OUR PEOPLE / Employee Profile

[Content]
The Group has a Recruitment and Hiring Policy in place to guide recruitment procedures and to ensure consistency. The recruitment process is transparent and fair. We select candidates solely on the basis of qualifications, experience and personal abilities. There are clear conditions and restrictions when an employee's relatives apply for an opening and the concerned applicant has to disclose that. This helps avoid preferential selection.

results.text: A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

[Section]
Materiality Assessment

[Content]
A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

results.text: The Group protects intellectual property rights of both itself and third parties. The Corporate Human Resources Department is responsible for providing guidelines on protecting intellectual property rights, and managing related assets such as logos, patents, trademarks and service marks, domain names, copyrights for both hardware and software etc. The use of all copyrighted materials of the Group should be authorised by the Corporate HR Department. As stated in the Code of Conduct, all employees who have the right to access or control proprietary information are required to prevent abuse or misuse by applying adequate protection measures.

Product Responsibility

[Content]
The Group protects intellectual property rights of both itself and third parties. The Corporate Human Resources Department is responsible for providing guidelines on protecting intellectual property rights, and managing related assets such as logos, patents, trademarks and service marks, domain names, copyrights for both hardware and software etc. The use of all copyrighted materials of the Group should be authorised by the Corporate HR Department. As stated in the Code of Conduct, all employees who have the right to access or control proprietary information are required to prevent abuse or misuse by applying adequate protection measures.

results.text: The Group ensures adherence to labour standards and prohibits all forms of unethical practices, which also applies to its suppliers and subcontractors. We take rigorous measures to prohibit child labour or forced labour. In order to prevent hiring child labour or forced labour, the Human Resource Department conducts a background check of all job applicants under the Background Check Policy to verify their identities and age during the recruitment process. We strictly comply with relevant labour laws and regulations in places of operations. In case of any instance of child employment, we would immediately terminate the contract.
